_doc: No Justice, step 3 (#843's plan, #934): the hideout fight. The lines are docs/scripts/no_justice.json's scenes ride (trail, warn, watch) and fight (crew_alarm, crew_call, crew_hit, runs, crew_quit, joe_call, mine), said as written there (status new or bible, all PROPOSED); Joe's own fight lines (hit, down_leg, up, fled, over) are CompanionBrain's (config/companion_joe.json). From the camp's end (step 2: Joe has read the trail, nojustice.trail = hideout): you set off along it with Joe and the ride's a card (riding isn't built, #478) to the hideout, coming in the unseen way off the mesa (valley.json's mesa_back_trail) onto the slope west of the line shack, above it. Joe: 'Fresh. We are close.', then his warning (ride.warn). Up on the slope he counts them in a whisper and asks how you want it (ride.watch). You choose by doing: creep in, or open fire. The crew (the end of Kett's, C5 b: five men and Kett) are about their camp on the hideout's pad: OutlawBrains posted (`hold`), the alarm when one sees you or Joe, hears a shot, or is hit; the man who sees says the alarm (`Riders! On the hill!` with you up the slope, else `We got company!`); their calls, hits and the last man's quitting are the script's lines in their own mouths (OutlawBrain.own_lines). Kett (Silas Kett, the faded red shirt, S1: a stand-in shirt colour) has no gun on him and no fight in him: at the alarm he breaks for the shack, a man yells after him (fight.runs) and Joe calls it (joe_call); in, he shuts the door and bars it (FalseFrontBuilding.shut_door). Shot dead outside by you: 'That was mine to take.' (fight.mine). The act ends with the crew out of it (dead, down, given up or run off) and Kett barred in (nojustice.kett = holed_up; step 4 forces the door), or dead or down outside. Facts: nojustice.hideout, nojustice.kett, nojustice.started, nojustice.crew, nojustice.seen (a man got away), nojustice.joe. Started from the camp's end (NoJusticeCamp), by `-- --world=valley --mission=no_justice_hideout` (step 2 done, you and Joe at the camp's trail) or the bridge's `moment no_justice_hideout set_up=1 [arrive=1]`.
status: PROPOSED (#934): the set, the posts, the timings and the stand-ins are this session's. Open: the hideout is open slope in the valley's ground (no canyon walls: #700's box canyon isn't in the terrain yet); no woodpile in the kit (the script's 'Behind the woodpile!' waits for one); the shack is the code's FalseFrontBuilding as a gable shack; the fire is a light and two logs.
_frame: Points are [east, south] metres off the place's `at` (valley.json hideout: [-450, 2020], its pad 30 x 20 at y 86), on the ground.

trail._doc: From the camp's end: walk this far on toward the hideout (within `off_deg` of it) with Joe within `joe_m` and the ride's card comes up.

ride._doc: The card: the camp to the hideout by the mesa's back way, its length from the camp's trail end (straight to the back trail's top, then the trail) at a horse's walk; the clock goes on by it.

shack._doc: A line shack: FalseFrontBuilding as a gable shack, its front (and door) to the north; `at` its middle.
shack._doorstep: A flat stone [width, depth] before the door, half the floor's height: you step 0.3 m at most (#966).

horses._doc: Their horses on a picket line east of the shack, below the pad's edge, out of the line from the slope (#5: no shooting animals; a ball still hits them).

prompts.barred: The red shirt's barred himself in the shack.
prompts.over_holed_up: It's quiet out here. The red shirt's barred in the shack.
prompts.over_dead: It's quiet. The red shirt's dead.
prompts.over_down: It's quiet. The red shirt's down in the dirt, alive.
prompts.retry: You went down at the hideout. Enter: ride back out with Joe and try it again.

cards.ride: You ride on with Joe on their trail, the back way off the mesa. %d minutes.
